svg.title: Family tree of inference frameworks: people, labs, companies
svg.text: Family tree of inference frameworks: people, labs, companies
Four families, four generations: from labs and individuals, to open projects, to companies, to where they landed. Legend below.
Sky Lab (the Spark and Ray line)
Kwon, Stoica, Simon Mo et al.
Solid: created, founded or directly derived (e.g. the Berkeley lab built vLLM)
Dashed: indirect links: people moving, forks, embedding, hosting, acquisitions (the small tag says which)
Sources: project papers, company announcements, SEC filings and press (see Sources). People moves with only one secondary source are left out.
